about: natural passages through the reef, kept open: no raise patch may touch them (DATA.md, “Patches, on any pack”)

properties.name: the Pearl Harbor entrance (Puʻuloa), inside the bar
properties.note: the dotted channel of the 1881 sheet from the narrows to its south end above the bar; traced at 0.00003° a pixel

properties.name: Māmala, the passage into Honolulu Harbour (Kou)
properties.note: the harbour off the 1881 town and the channel through the reef to the bar, between the reef stipple each side; traced at 0.00003° a pixel

properties.name: the Pearl Harbor bar
properties.note: from the south end of the dotted channel to the 4-fathom line of the 1881 sheet, which writes “3 Bar”; the 1899 sheet sounds 1½ to 3½ there, Corney in 1818 “not more than 15 feet ... at high water”: never shallower than 3.5 m, about two fathoms at low water

properties.name: the Honolulu bar
properties.note: the reef edge off the passage, where the 1881 sheet sounds 1½ to 3½ fathoms by the spar buoy and the 1890–92 cut went through a bar of as little as 18 feet: never shallower than 5.5 m
